findings.finding: The visible declared date is not compared to the approved date.
findings.mechanism: The date check binds record/config/scientific metadata but only tests that a generic entry-meta prefix occurs in HTML.
findings.reproduction: For either actual article replace the single visible date before </time> by 1 January 2030, retaining all meta/JSON-LD/config fields.

findings.finding: Visible entry-meta and citation edition labels are not checked for these IDs.
findings.mechanism: The generic edition_label test explicitly excludes CD_IDS. The CD-specific test validates metadata version, not either visible label.
findings.reproduction: Change only the entry-meta edition after </time> from version1.0 to9.9, or only (Version1.0) [Preprint] in Cite this paper to (Version9.9) [Preprint]. Exact actual scripts preserve spacing and mutate the actual reads in memory.
findings.actual_result: PASS with all checks, exit0 in all four controls
findings.expected_result: Reject an unapproved visible edition or citation edition.

findings.finding: Discotope can lose the whole approved c.status paragraph and still pass.
findings.mechanism: Only used extensively/human/formal substrings are required in the status section; the remaining ai_disclosure paragraph supplies all three. The exact ai_disclosure is tested, but exact c.status or complete status paragraph list is not.
findings.reproduction:
Remove exactly

HTML-escaped c.status

from the actual Discotope HTML read.
findings.expected_result: Reject removal of an approved status paragraph.
findings.comparison: The corresponding Cylinder omission rejects because its remaining disclosure lacks formal; this is accidental coverage and not an exact status contract.
